item.title: REPLAY: Burnham, Von der Leyen hail 'turning point' in EU-UK relations
item.description: British Prime Minister Andy Burnham hailed a "landmark" deal with the European Union on Friday, as the two sides sealed pacts on food exports, emissions-trading schemes and youth mobility at a summit in Brussels. EU chief Ursula von der Leyen welcomed a "turning point" in ties with Britain following Brexit. Watch our replay.

item.title: COP31 wrapping up in Turkey: Climate deal elusive as fossil fuels go unmentioned
item.description: The UN's COP31 climate talks were set to spill into overtime Friday as countries remained deadlocked over a draft deal that makes no mention of fossil fuels, with a host of other disputes also snarling negotiations. The talks come with a series of stark reminders of the urgency of climate action, from heatwaves in Europe and devastating floods in Nepal, while a record-breaking El Nino supercharges temperatures. FRANCE 24's Environment Editor Valerie Dekimpe tells us more.

item.title: Burnham hails 'landmark' EU-UK deal as 'good day' for Britain, Europe
item.description: Britain and the European Union agreed deals on trade, carbon emissions and youth movement on Friday, and pledged to rebuild ties with an “ambitious and dynamic” post-Brexit relationship. In a joint statement after a summit in Brussels, the UK and EU confirmed agreements that will scrap checks on the trade in plant and animal products, link their emissions trading schemes and let 100,000 young adults from each side live and work in the other's countries for up to three years. FRANCE 24's International Affairs Editor Kethevane Gorjestani tells us more.

item.title: Russia pummels Ukraine with massive strikes, missile hits Poland
item.description: Moscow pounded Ukraine with massive strikes Friday, with Kyiv saying at least six people were killed in the capital, and neighbouring Poland reporting two Russian missiles likely landed in the south-east corner of the NATO country, accusing Moscow of a "provocation." Hours earlier, Russia's Vladimir Putin vowed a "painful" response to Kyiv's strikes on Moscow's Crimea bridge after holding a summit with China's Xi Jinping and US President Donald Trump. FRANCE 24's Gulliver Cragg reports from Kyiv, Ukraine.

item.title: 'GTA VI': When the biggest-ever entertainment release becomes the biggest headline
item.description: This week FRANCE 24's media show "Scoop" looks at how the press covered the release of "Grand Theft Auto VI". Pre-orders and first-day sales totalled more than $2.3 billion. What does the game and the franchise's success mean for the future of entertainment? Our guest is Margaret Wallace, a video game developer and an associate professor of the practice of media innovation at Boston University.
